title: Qualitative Analysis of a Three-Stage Anaerobic Digestion Model with Microbial Decay
summary: We extend a three-stage anaerobic digestion model by incorporating microbial mortality into the hydrolysis of particulate organic matter. The model describes hydrolysis, acidogenesis, and methanogenesis, each with distinct dilution and decay rates, and accounts for non-monotonic growth in order to capture substrate inhibition. Two hydrolysis mechanisms are considered: a first-order formulation and a biomass-dependent one.
